Why Institutions Choose APSHULE

Practical tools for teams that need useful information even when the connection is unreliable.

📶 Offline first

Keep working without internet and sync safely when connection returns.

Use phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops without changing your workflow.

Support English, Luganda, Lusoga, Runyankore, Runyoro, Acholi, and Swahili.

Generate lesson plans, activity ideas, and useful operational summaries.

Cartoon Studio

Turn a short English lesson script into a six-scene slideshow with captions and browser voiceover. Generation requires an internet connection; the finished lesson can be cached for offline playback.

Lesson brief

Maximum 2,000 characters0/2000
Voiceover uses the browser's SpeechSynthesis when no managed audio provider is configured. No fake audio URL is saved, and the slideshow remains playable with captions if voiceover is unavailable.

    Our Vision

    To be Africa's leading digital learning platform transforming education through innovation and accessibility for every student across the continent and beyond.

    Accessibility: Making education available to all students
